messages:
ben: hey all, joining today. quick Q: who's the go-to for ownership questions during onboarding? e.g., model catalog, private deploy approvals, and who to page for infra P0s?

talia: welcome ben! short map: model catalog & verification -> @alex (eng-runtime). private/VPC deploy approvals -> @mina (infra). P0s -> page @eng-sre/oncall first.

alex: for model onboarding, open a model-ticket and attach evals + perf numbers. runtime triages verification and schedules a 24h staging canary before catalog approval.

mina: infra tickets for VPC or access: use infra queue and tag `onboard-expedite` if you need to move faster. include subnet IDs and intended CIDR. DM me the ticket to bump priority.

ben: thanks! what's the escalation path if a staging canary leaks into prod routing or causes high latency?

talia: PagerDuty pages the oncall engineer first. escalation: oncall -> oncall lead -> eng-sre manager. if customer data involved, page security (@jordan) and add `sensitive=true`. post the incident link in #incidents.

ops-bot: Action: added ben to `dev-access` and `redwood-oncall`.

ben: great. any must-join channels for first week?

mina: join #eng-runtime, #infra, #incidents, and #onboarding. also check the Owners Matrix doc in Confluence.

ben: will do, thanks everyone!
